gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-esteban: Stencilia stands structural and striking up top, with generous gaps where its curves end, while Esteban follows in a classic serif whose lowercase runs large. The heading hits hard and the body softens it.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-faustina: Blocky and bold-faced, Stencilia leads with spacious curve endings, then Faustina arrives as a text serif whose bowls thin gently, like a pen at rest. The two split the work cleanly.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-halant: Stencilia brings a structural, striking look, with generous openings at its curve ends and a tight gap under the ascender line, while Halant gives it a text serif with towering lowercase. Halant's faint thick-thin shift is the pair's real strength.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-headland-one: Stencilia hits like cut stone. Headland One answers in a dignified serif with gently varied strokes and round, tall o shapes that sit well apart from one another.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Stencilia leaves generous gaps where its curves finish. Hedvig Letters Serif takes over below as a serif with sturdy tall lowercase and medium contrast, so the heading's structure gets a readable partner.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-lisu-bosa: Stencilia's curves end with spacious gaps, giving the heading a structural, striking look. Lisu Bosa is the text serif doing the quieter job, with tall lowercase that makes words look sturdy and counters that spill open.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-marcellus-sc: Stencilia's curve endings sit wide apart, giving it a striking frame. Marcellus SC is the one that adds literary dignity, with gentle modulation and lowercase that carries the stature of cast iron capitals.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-montagu-slab: Stencilia leaves wide gaps at its curve terminals and tucks its ascenders in close. Montagu Slab, a classic serif with a soft robust-to-slender contrast and a sizable x-height, gives the page somewhere comfortable to land.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-serif-henta: Stencilia's curves end with spacious gaps, which gives it its structure. Make that heading small or the Noto Serif Hentaigana body large and the classic serif's modulation and near-capital-height lowercase start competing for attention.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-ovo: Ovo reads as a classic serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, thins just slightly lighter than its thicks. Beneath Stencilia's structural heading, a body size a notch up lets those tall lowercase forms breathe.
